game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Dune Crest, a high dune crest: the caravan guide must hold off giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Exception Rodeo: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dune Crest: a high dune crest
core_gameplay_loop: In Dune Crest, repeat each round: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing. Then check stability and advance.
player_objective: Protect the caravan wagon from giant scorpions in Dune Crest: keep stability above zero until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Exception Rodeo
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 2, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Sand Dunes
